# CANDIDATE: ORB_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Heavy one-sided volume in the opening range often exhausts, leading to a pullback toward the day-VWAP. We aim to capture the fade of the opening range extreme on a volume-imbalance short bias.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the first 30-minute bar's high exceeds the opening range high AND cumulative delta (buying pressure) > 2 * ATR(20) AND price closes in the upper 20% of the opening range AND price < VWAP AND EMA8 < EMA21 (bearish ribbon), enter short at the next bar open.  
Exit shape: Chart-stop at the opening range high (invalidation), TP1 at 1R to VWAP, runner trail 10% off HWM.  
Regime hint: Works when VIX <20 (low volatility) and time 09:45-10:30; avoid days with ADX >25 (strong trend).
